question: Is a single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) shared by F1/F2a/F2b at the frozen G-FORM hashes, and is the C0=>C2 transfer licensed for every member of the declared domain?
method: Deterministic read-only checker (stdlib+PyYAML) over byte snapshots of the three canonical schemas and the canonical F0 taxonomy. A strict YAML loader records duplicate mapping keys instead of PyYAML last-wins. Normalized mathematical signatures (matter, Lambda, equations, constraints, regularity default, Sobolev s/delta/spaces, decay, parity, symmetry) are compared pairwise; structural deltas are reported separately. D0 is inspected for a two-member disjunction against the pair-indexed formal binder. Implication ledgers are scanned for C0=>C2 entailments/forbidden transfers; must_not_conflate is cross-checked against containment claims; approval/stability-argument keywords are searched in all four artifacts.
criterion: G-FORM.unmet item 4: no single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) is shared by F1/F2a/F2b, which disables the licensed C0=>C2 transfer

H1_same_mathematical_data_class.note: normalized; F2a==F2b byte-key-identical, F1 differs structurally (extra excluded_data; adm_mass.rigidity present, locator absent; parity/diffeo wording)

H2_single_frozen_s_delta.note: false in 3/3 schemas: D0 = 'Sobolev variant s>5/2 and delta in (1/2,1), or the smooth-with-decay default' while the formal statement is 'forall (s,delta) in D0: ...'

H3_c0_to_c2_transfer.note: ledger edges recorded in F2a and F2b; no approximation/stability argument found in any of the four artifacts; F1 must_not_conflate forbids smooth->Sobolev transfer without one

H4_ledger_vs_prohibition.note: F2b retains 'No containment with C2 or C0 is asserted here' while its ledger asserts E_H2loc subset E_C0; F2a carries the corrected wording

findings.finding: matter/Lambda/equations/constraints/decay/Sobolev pair agree across F1/F2a/F2b after normalizing prose (citation status, ownership, parenthetical naming); the remaining cross-schema differences are structural, see W029C-02
F1's data_class is structurally not byte-identical to F2a/F2b (extra key and wording/status deltas); F2a and F2b are key-identical

no single frozen (s,delta,norm): D0 is a two-member domain (Sobolev pair OR smooth-with-decay default) in all three schemas, and the formal binder 'forall (s,delta) in D0' is ill-typed on the smooth member

the C0=>C2 ledger edges are recorded, but F1's must_not_conflate forbids smooth-data statements being transferred to the Sobolev variant without an approximation/stability argument, and no such argument is recorded in any of the three schemas or the canonical F0 taxonomy; with a disjunctive D0 the transfer is therefore licensed only member-wise
retained 'No containment with C2 or C0 is asserted here' sentence contradicts the same file's implication_ledger containment claim (F2a already carries the corrected wording)
all three frozen schemas carry duplicate top-level YAML mapping keys (last-wins under PyYAML); the duplicate-key defect class is therefore cross-schema, not F1-only

gate_effect: CONFIRMS the recorded G-FORM unmet criterion rather than refuting it; no gate verdict is set or moved by this worker artifact.
assumptions: The frozen canonical hashes are the ones measured at 2026-09-12T00:28:48+08:00 and were stable at the later re-measure inside the checker run (live_drift_vs_snapshot=false for all three).

Normalization strips only prose that does not change mathematical content (citation status, ownership clauses, parenthetical naming); the raw structural deltas are reported so a reader can re-judge that normalization.
The C0=>C2 transfer question is decided from the recorded implication ledgers plus the recorded prohibitions; it is not a re-derivation of the mathematics.
falsifier: Any revision of F1/F2a/F2b in which D0's definition names a single pair-indexed domain that supplies an (s,delta) for every member (or the smooth member is removed to a registered variant), and in which the C0=>C2 transfer carries a recorded approximation/stability argument (or F1's prohibition is withdrawn), falsifies this measurement. A live hash different from the pinned snapshots also voids it.
